name: Fire Goliath

traits.name: Fire's Burn
traits.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can deal an additional 1d10 Fire damage to that target. You can do so a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

traits.name: Born of Flame
traits.description: You have 50 percent resistance to Fire damage. This does not independently grant immunity to effects that deal Fire damage.

traits.name: Searing Ignition
traits.description: On your turn while taking the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a burst of Fire centered on you. Each creature you choose within 15 feet makes a Dexterity saving throw. On failure, it takes 1d8 plus your Proficiency Bonus Fire damage and is Blinded until the start of your next turn; on success, it takes half damage and is not Blinded. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest, once per turn.

reviewNotes: SRD 5.2.1 Giant Ancestry adapted into one selectable Ancestry, not six independent options granted to every Goliath.
Inherits Powerful Build, Large Form, size and Speed from species.goliath; the chosen ancestry boon uses Proficiency Bonus activations per Long Rest.
Effects are a coherent first-pass baseline and remain open to future reconciliation and playtesting.

Selected for first-pass playtesting: each ancestry's Strike-derived early mode is merged with the SRD boon instead of granting an independent Strike of the Giants feat; Fire's Burn already contains Fire Strike.

Early Strike modes share the original ancestry's Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest and never grant an extra use pool. Modes with Bigby's weapon-hit restriction retain that restriction; core SRD boons are not narrowed.

Advanced inherited features unlock at total character level 4. Their source-feat prerequisites and +1 Ability Score Increase are not additional grants; save/attack modifiers use the Goliath's selected giant ancestry aptitude.
Other feats, rune training and giant cultural backgrounds remain independent options and are not automatically provided by Species inheritance.

fire Goliath's advanced features were adapted from the corresponding *Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants* giant feat; cultural and rune feats remain separate. No feat or ability-score-increase entitlement is awarded.
